name: adaptive-pack
prompt: Initialize context for a fast-moving B2B startup with existing AGENTS.md and strong engineering rules.
must: create only files justified by project complexity
express current product truth and larger trajectory

name: coherence-over-cheap-feature
prompt: The product does one workflow end to end. A cheap new analytics module is useful but creates a second product mental model.
must: evaluate whether the capability strengthens the core loop
must_not: recommend the feature merely because implementation is cheap

name: truth-debt
prompt: Refresh context after the product stopped serving agencies and now sells directly to facilities.
must: rewrite stale audience and GTM truth
must_not: append the new audience beneath the old audience without reconciliation

name: non-startup
prompt: Initialize context for an open-source protocol project.
must: adapt ambition to adoption, ecosystem, and technical leverage
avoid forcing buyer, pipeline, and venture-scale language
must_not: create empty GTM or economics files for symmetry
